messages:
Ria (partnerships): quick sync 1: partner onboarding for marketplace listings (AWS/GCP/Azure). goal: publish trial image + trial entitlement flow + partner-facing doc. need to lock IAM artifacts, artifact upload method, and legal attestation.
Lena (legal): please get me the exact trial wording they plan to display. also confirm data processing location and retention.
Omar (product): trial = 14-day access, soft limits: 5 concurrent seats, compute metered. wed like a visible badge: \"Trial - 14 days\" on listing.
Chen (eng): artifacts: for AWS well need an AMI (signed), for GCP a shared image or importer link, for Azure either a VHD or container image in MCR. also SBOM + image scan reports.
Nikhil (cloud-ops): to publish we need: publisher AWS account ID + cross-account role ARN, GCP project + service account email with compute.imageUser, Azure publisher ID + storage SAS or ACR push. doc will list exact names.
Irene (partner-success): partner prefers a one-click trial. can we pre-create trial entitlements so partners can activate without paperwork?
Ria (partnerships): ideally yes. propose we create a short-lived entitlement token we provide them. ops: is that feasible?
Nikhil (cloud-ops): feasible: create an ephemeral tenant in our staging org, issue tokens with TTL 30 days. need confirmation on quotas.
Tara (security): images must pass our vulnerability policy: no critical vulns, high must be reviewed. require SBOM and signing. also include minimal runtime user, disable SSH root login.
Lena (legal): add a clause: \"By activating the trial you consent to ephemeral telemetry collection to support performance / billing. No customer content will be stored beyond 30 days unless explicitly opted-in.\" send me the final draft.
Chen (eng): devops snippet for assume role wed accept (AWS):
```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::PUBLISHER_ACCOUNT_ID:role/MarketplacePublishRole"},"Action":"sts:AssumeRole"}]}
```
Chen (eng): GCP: provide SA key or grant our publisher-uploader SA roles: roles/compute.imageUser + roles/storage.objectViewer on bucket.
Nikhil (cloud-ops): timeline: once we have signed AMI + legal attestation + billing SKU mapping, publishing window ~ 48h for AWS/GCP; Azure can be 3-5 days.
Irene (partner-success): i'll request partner to upload artifacts to our staging bucket and share link + checksum. prefer gzipped tar of images.
Publish-Bot: publisher-staging-creds created -> https://ci.internal/creds/ps-2026 (expires 2026-04-15)
Ria (partnerships): action items: 1) Chen + Nikhil: publish checklist + exact role names (EOD tomorrow). 2) Lena + Omar: trial T&Cs + listing blurb (48h). 3) Irene: get artifact link + checksum from partner (EOD). 4) Tara: security baseline + scan gate details (EOD).
Omar (product): i'll draft a short QA checklist to verify entitlement activation and metering (will include curl examples).
Chen (eng): i'll also produce a tiny perf note (memory/cpu recommended instance types) for the listing and a minimal smoke test script.
Tara (security): i'll prepare a template attestation (data residency + logging) partner can sign; will include required headers for SBOM.
Lena (legal): note: we'll need to confirm the trial refund/charge policy if they convert early. add to the T&Cs.
Irene (partner-success): partner replied: aiming to upload tonight. asked about required file names and manifest format.
Ria (partnerships): manifest format: include fields: name, version, sku_id, trial_days, entitlements=["trial"], checksum, sbom_link. Chen please post a small JSON example.
Chen (eng): example manifest:
```json
{"name":"redwood-demo","version":"1.0.0","sku":"SKU-TRIAL-001","trial_days":14,"entitlements":["trial"],"checksum":"sha256:...","sbom":"https://..."}
```
Nikhil (cloud-ops): logging: enable publisher audit logs to our ingestion endpoint for 30 days. Tara, fine with that retention?
Tara (security): yes for trial telemetry. anything longer requires opt-in.
Ria (partnerships): great. we'll reconvene tomorrow after checklists are in. thumbs up or blockers?
Chen (eng): blocker: partner must provide signed AMI/GCP image or give uploader access.
Irene (partner-success): confirmation: partner will grant uploader access by 21:00 UTC.
Lena (legal): blocker: none from me if T&Cs drafted and attestation provided.
Ria (partnerships): thanks all. i'll produce a one-pager runbook for the partner with links to the checklists and the publish ticket. :sparkles:
